newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-STEAUA HIT BACK TO BEAT PSG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STEAUA HIT BACK TO BEAT PSG.

text.p: Steaua Bucharest twice came from behind to beat Paris St. Germain 3-2 in their European Cup preliminary round first-leg clash on Wednesday.
Veteran Marius Lacatus hit the winner 11 minutes from the finish.
PSG, launching dangerous and fast counter-attacks, seized the lead in the 19th minute through Vincent Guerin.
Steaua equalised with an Iosif Rotariu spot kick in the 54th minute but the French side went ahead again through Florian Maurice 10 minutes later.
Denis Serban put Steaua back on terms in the 71st minute before Lacatus fired the winner eight minutes later.
